expressions.cue: Position 1 in an ordered list. Use 番目, not just its 番 label.
expressions.explanation: 目 marks position in a sequence here. 二回 is twice; 二回目 is the second time. Keep the counter's own reading before め; alternate written counters do not change the displayed reading.
